cross_references.note: §3202 is listed in lab_4553 as a prerequisite cross-reference. Ambiguities in 'managing representative' and in the 'serious and willful' threshold are resolved in the worker's favor under §3202.
§3202 applies to ambiguities in what constitutes 'reasonably required to cure or relieve' under §4600. Liberal construction extends the scope of required medical treatment.

§3202 applies to ambiguities in §4663 apportionment methodology — particularly what constitutes a 'causative factor.' Ambiguous apportionment disputes resolve in the worker's favor, meaning less apportionment to non-industrial causes.

§3202 applies to ambiguities in §4610 UR procedure — particularly timeliness requirements and the physician-only modification/denial rule. Ambiguous UR requirements are construed against the employer.
